# Validate current change

1. Read `AGENTS.md` and the relevant Issue/request.
2. Inspect the diff and identify affected subsystems/platforms.
3. Run the smallest relevant automated checks plus broader checks required by impact.
4. Check repo-local status/docs that `AGENTS.md` says must stay aligned.
5. Explicitly separate checks actually run from checks still pending/unavailable.
6. Do not infer runtime/device/server/external success from buildability alone.
7. Report unrelated defects separately instead of silently expanding scope.
